column1: # Profiles Tessera bundles, and where each one comes from.
# Tab-separated with `#` comments, because both the vendoring script and the
# application read this file and neither should need a parser library to do it.
# One description of the fact: what is expected here, what it is called, and
# under what terms it may be shipped.
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   file      the name it is saved under in this directory
#   space     CMYK, RGB or Grey. Checked after downloading, so a URL that has
#             rotted into an HTML error page is caught rather than bundled
#   licence   a tag; the full terms are in LICENCES.md, which must have an entry
#   name      what to call it in the interface
#   source    where to fetch it
# NOTHING IS BUNDLED UNTIL `tools/vendor-profiles.py` HAS BEEN RUN. The
# application offers whichever of these files is actually present, so a fresh
# checkout has a shorter list rather than a broken one.
# URLs rot. The script reports a fetch that fails and carries on with the rest;
# pass `--url` to give a moved file its new address, and please correct the row.
# See CANDIDATES.md for the CMYK presses that are freely licensed but are not
# listed here yet, and what has to be confirmed before they can be.
sRGB2014.icc
sRGB_v4_ICC_preference.icc
